One token over thousands of data APIs from many vendors: people and company enrichment, email finding, search results and scraping. Pay per call from a prepaid balance, at each vendor's own rate.

**Used by:** [OpenCRM](/docs/apps/crm) for enriching contacts and companies (optional).

## API key

1. Sign up at [treg.to](https://treg.to). New accounts get $1 of credit.
2. Use a team kept for this Gateway: a call can reach any vendor account the team has connected.
3. Install Treg's CLI and sign in (`treg login`), then create a team token: `treg org agent-new <name>`.
4. Copy the token.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add treg
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  treg: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Treg's [API](https://treg.to/integrate.md) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show treg` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Charged per call at the vendor's own rate, no markup, from a prepaid balance: a people lookup is $0.001 to $0.28. X-Treg-Cost-Micro reports each charge; X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost caps a call.

## Treg's MCP server

Treg also has an MCP server. It takes the same token, so there is nothing more to set:

```bash
everyapp mcp add https://treg.to/mcp/
```

Its tools then show up for your AI clients as `treg_<tool>`. More in [MCP apps](/docs/agent/mcp).

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Treg).
